storage.built_in: 4 TB M.2 SSD (video data); 128 GB M.2 SSD (OS)

features: LTE modem (customer-supplied Nano SIM); LTE livestream up to 12 Mbps, 2 channels
Wired livestream up to 48 Mbps, 8 channels; playback up to 24 Mbps, 4 channels; combined wired output cannot exceed 48 Mbps
0-60 W per PoE port; one PoE++ port can be used as the outbound network connection
Classified Object Detection, Appearance Search, Facial Recognition (license), Visible Firearm Detection (license), Occupancy Counting
No video outputs, web-based administration only
notes: Fact sheet states support for up to four cameras; datasheet gives up to 8 recording channels.
